task.problem_statement: Higher-order qubit excitations currently fall back to a large Pauli decomposition. Users need optimized decompositions for excitations beyond singles and doubles while preserving the action on the quantum state, including arbitrary complex input states.
requirements: Compile higher-order qubit excitations with smaller circuit depth than their Pauli decomposition.
Preserve the state transformation of the Pauli decomposition for triple and five-fold excitations, including normalized complex input states and numerical rotation angles.

interface.Name: QubitExcitation
interface.Description: Constructs a qubit excitation; target indices form excitation pairs and compile_options="pauli" selects the reference decomposition.

interface.Name: compile_circuit
interface.Description: Compiles a circuit and exposes its depth and simulation-compatible action.
